title: Sylveon Point Salad Eevee Edition Korean Pokemon Card Game NM/M
description:
Sylveon single card from Point Salad: Eevee Edition, the 2019 Korean-exclusive Pokemon card game (AEG).

This is one card from the card-drafting game, not a Pokemon TCG playing card. One side shows a full-art Sylveon illustration under a "Yawn" (하품) move ribbon; the flip side is the scoring/index face showing Umbreon, Eevee and Sylveon with their point values (2 / 2 / 4). Both sides are photographed - please judge condition for yourself from the images, as they are of the actual card you will receive.

- Game: Point Salad - Eevee Edition (Korean exclusive)
- Publisher: AEG (Alderac Entertainment Group), 2019
- Featured Pokemon: Sylveon / Umbreon / Eevee
- Single card, ungraded

Condition: New / Mint, pulled from the game and sleeved right away.

Shipping: FREE. Penny sleeve into a semi-rigid holder, shipped flat in a cardboard-reinforced envelope. Combined shipping on multiple purchases - just ask before paying.
